nodes.author: Haamid_234
nodes.text: @Parvaizkoul These are some common symptoms , that every person in kashmir feels during winters, then how could a person differentiate the two

nodes.author: Parvaizkoul
nodes.text: @Haamid_234 You are right. All respiratory viruses present with similar features and are aggressive in the very young, the older adults & those with comorbidities. Unfortunately we have treatment or vaccination available against only few. So prevention is important. Docs know when to test.
